versions.changelog:
- Initial release for 51job-hot-trend skill.
- Supports public job and company page summaries on 前程无忧 (51job.com).
- Provides keyword/city-based job highlights, position details, and company overviews.
- No login, resume submission, or bulk scraping; for lightweight, compliant data extraction only.
- Designed for information extraction and reminders from publicly available pages.
